name: chunky
description: PWA-first English chunk trainer for Russian speakers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @chunky/web" "npm run dev -w @chunky/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chunky/web && npm run build -w @chunky/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chunky/web && npm run typecheck -w @chunky/api
